raw.query: WITH burst AS (SELECT i.lead_s, BOOL_AND(i.is_violation) AS all_rows_violate, COUNT(*) AS rows_at_lead, MIN(i.n_requests) AS burst_requests, MAX(i.n_requests) AS burst_requests_max FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_infraction i USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current = true AND i.is_current = true AND i.policy = 'reactive' AND i.window_name = 'burst3' AND i.lead_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.lead_s), span AS (SELECT MAX(d.window_requests) AS span_requests FROM provenance.v_dim d WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.window_name = 'aggregate' AND d.window_requests IS NOT NULL) SELECT ARRAY_AGG(lead_s ORDER BY lead_s) AS tested_leads_s, BOOL_AND(all_rows_violate) AS reactive_violates_at_every_tested_lead, SUM(rows_at_lead) AS infraction_rows, MIN(burst_requests) AS burst3_requests, MAX(burst_requests_max) AS burst3_requests_max, span_requests, ROUND(100.0 * MIN(burst_requests) / span_requests, 4) AS burst3_percent_of_span FROM burst CROSS JOIN span GROUP BY span_requests
